svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Atlas Map view, Landscape (L0)
svg.desc: Estate Map view at Level 0: AWS, GCP and on-prem regions on a muted dot-matrix world map with worst-state health aggregates. eu-west-1 is Failing because cluster prod-eu-1 hosts checkout (INC-2041, since 12:22). Includes the view switcher (Alt+1..6), layer switcher, L0-L5 depth ladder, care queue and estate strip.
